multiple_testing_proposal.complements: tagged, counted in the registered denominator, excluded from the effective-independent estimate
multiple_testing_proposal.global_disclosure: Census-01 totals (38,192 strategy trials, 1,095 factors) are reported beside every Census-02 verdict
multiple_testing_proposal.local_family: Census-02 conditional factors form their own BH family (factor_fdr_bh_v1, alpha 0.10)
multiple_testing_proposal.registered_population: frozen population root over every (config x scope symbol) trial and every condition x horizon factor
multiple_testing_proposal.strategy_judge: DEFERRED_FULL_POPULATION; any later DSR/PBO denominator is the pooled Census-01 + Census-02 population

operator_decisions_required.etf_borrow_assumption: explicit list + annual fee bps (see c2_borrow)

proposed_etf_scope_for_operator_review.note: the registry carries no instrument-type field; ETF membership must be an explicit operator-frozen list

benchmark_semantics.never: long buy-and-hold as the benchmark of a short-bearing strategy (double-counts the market)

execution_contract.borrow_cost: short holding bars accrue |qty|*prior_close*annual_fee_bps/10000/252; fee has NO default; short rebate ZERO; availability/recall assumptions are disclosed, not asserted
execution_contract.corporate_actions: adjustment=all total-return series: a short bears dividends through the adjusted series; unsupported corporate actions stay typed EXCLUDED (fail closed)
execution_contract.fill: first bar strictly after t; BUY at high+slip, SELL at low-slip (rust_conservative_bar_range_v1, slippage 5 bps, integer micros); short entry = SELL, cover = BUY; same-bar fill forbidden
execution_contract.labels: fwd_ret/close_{t+h}/close_t-1 is a LABEL: EXECUTABLE_PNL=false, never an input to simulate_signed
execution_contract.signal_knowledge: signal on bar t uses only bars <= t
execution_contract.sizing: qty = sign*floor(10000 USD / completed-signal-bar close); constant per run; no compounding; sign flip = exit leg + entry leg on one fill bar
execution_contract.ssr: Rule 201 not represented; trigger is derivable from daily bars and is recorded as a per-fill flag only

identity.attempt: infrastructure retry = new attempt of the SAME trial; outcome-based retry forbidden

registration_rule.denominator: frozen population root; cannot shrink after results
registration_rule.winner_only_registration: forbidden: the complete ledger precedes any registry record

retry_rules.infrastructure_retry: same trial, new attempt, same economics
